restaurants.name: Sri Mu Saravana Bhavan
restaurants.ambience: Convenient and comfortable stop for early morning travellers
highlights: Ideal for early morning arrival breakfast stop
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Mattancherry Palace
attractions.description: A 16th-century Portuguese-built palace, later renovated by the Dutch, renowned for its exquisite Kerala-style murals depicting Hindu epics

attractions.name: Jewish Synagogue
attractions.description: The oldest active synagogue in the Commonwealth, renowned for its rich history and unique blend of Jewish and local Kerala influences
attractions.entry_fee: ₹5 for Indian visitors, ₹100 for foreign visitors

attractions.name: St. Francis Church
attractions.description: One of India's oldest European churches, this historic landmark carries stories from centuries of colonial history with simple architecture and peaceful surroundings.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Chinese Fishing Nets
attractions.description: Traditional cantilevered fishing nets introduced by Chinese explorer Zheng He in the 14th century, offering a unique glimpse into Kerala's maritime heritage

attractions.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
attractions.description: Built by the Portuguese and later renovated by the Dutch, this palace houses beautiful Kerala murals, royal artefacts and historic exhibits providing a glimpse into Kerala's royal past.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Paradesi Jewish Synagogue
attractions.description: One of the oldest active synagogues in the Commonwealth, known for hand-painted Chinese tiles, Belgian chandeliers and centuries of history.
attractions.hours: 10:00 AM – 06:00 PM (Closed on Saturdays and Jewish holidays)
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx
